scope: Actor isolation, authorization, one-shot retry, late publication and obvious compile hazards only; root separately owns UI and overall scope
checks: MainActor presentation serializes start before first suspension; busy plus task prevent overlapping row operations; close cancels and awaits the same task
Engine file reference is explicitly module-qualified, avoiding existing Host type ambiguity
Real status stays separate from native204 acknowledgement; status decode binds exact file/object/account through existing Engine API
Native session lease, mounted owner and exact chosen-file metadata bracket are checked before delivery; revoked/cancelled owner cannot publish status
Retry write ACL and mounted canMutate/no-pending-edit checks occur in the original dispatch authorization; actor consumes approval once and uncertain outcome has no automatic retry
Acknowledgement is recorded only after existing retry returns, preserved if a later status/metadata read fails, and never converted into durable state
Failures retain existing discardVisibleFiles behavior; late inactive errors do not repopulate visible status
Existing AnyNativeFileDurability API and AnyApplicationSession source were read; AnyDocumentPresentation canMutate/requireMounted/lifecycle definitions align with the new closures
limits: No Swift typecheck, UI, native, component or control execution
Concrete AnyHTTPTorahTargetAccess implementation was not independently re-fetched in this narrow review; uses the existing original read/write API
